list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18)
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list. Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, from the official description — the game is a day old and the steps are not yet checked in play, so where the description names no place or method we say so instead of inventing one.

exophase.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
psnprofiles.covers: Official list, and PSN's progress count where one is tracked

own.name: This guide — our own advice
own.covers: Steps written from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands when the other 54 are earned — there is no shortcut and no separate task. Work the roadmap in order, keep the meditation set moving as you travel, and save the 100% completion push for last: 'A Long Road' is the final gate before this one pops.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies, in roadmap order.
Clear 'A Long Road' (100% completion) last.
The platinum unlocks with the final trophy.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the story and unlocks as you play through the opening — nothing here can be missed, just follow the opening beats.
steps: Start the story and play the opening mission.
Finish Gone Fishing to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter closes — keep following the story missions and it comes on its own.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 1.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like every chapter trophy, it pops when the chapter's final mission is done — there is nothing extra to do.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 2.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. The chapter trophy unlocks with its final mission, so just keep the story moving.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 3.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. The last chapter before the finale — finish its missions and the trophy is yours.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 4.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission — the last story beat, worth gold. In GTA's usual structure the open world stays open after the story, so you can leave the finale until your cleanup is done and play it last.
steps: Clear your cleanup list first if you like — the finale waits.
Play and finish the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as the story reaches it — follow the mission markers and finish it.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission in the story's flow — play it when it opens and finish the job.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Complete the heist mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It comes up in the story's order — finish the mission and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Another mission trophy — it unlocks when the mission is done, no extra condition.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission like the others in this set — play it through to the end.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, stranger strand, activity, collectible set and challenge the game counts. Use the in-game stats to see what is left, and clear the big sets first — cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots and explored areas — because this is the last big gate before the platinum.
steps: Finish the story and every stranger strand.
Clear the big sets: cards, WAiNK, meditation, areas.
Check in-game stats for the remaining percent, then mop up.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all count toward the total. The count climbs fastest when you chain them while driving between objectives instead of fast-travelling: treat every drive as a stunt run and the number takes care of itself.
steps: Drive everywhere instead of fast-travelling.
Chain jumps, drifts and near misses on each drive.
PSN tracks the count to 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, races and the rest. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish them all, just sample each type.
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Try each type once, in any order.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold needs speed and accuracy together: learn each challenge's layout first with a slow run, then push for the gold time. The range is the one place to practise without the open world getting in the way.
steps: Run each challenge once slowly to learn it.
Replay for the gold medal, 42 in all.
PSN tracks the count to 42.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own course — win one race per location and the set is done. Fly the course once slowly to learn the gates, then race it.
steps: Find each of the 14 Top Fun locations.
Win one drone race at each location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts as long as each win is a different race — repeat wins on the same course do not add to the 20, so keep entering new ones.
steps: Enter races you have not won yet.
Win 20 different races in all.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The challenge is head-to-head: out-fish Cal in one challenge and it pops. Take your time with each catch instead of rushing the reel.
steps: Take on a fishing challenge against Cal.
Out-fish him to win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet and play it through to the end — one finished game is all it takes.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play one game through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a side-mission chain: keep taking his missions when they appear and the finale unlocks at the end of it.
steps: Take Andy's missions whenever they appear.
Play his final mission to the end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand runs as a side-mission chain — follow it through its missions and the finale closes it.
steps: Take Kenton's missions whenever they appear.
Play his final mission to the end.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is a side-mission chain like the others: keep answering his calls and the finale unlocks at the end.
steps: Take Billy's missions whenever they appear.
Play his final mission to the end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore — take each one when you find it and keep its chain going. Eight finished strands earns the silver.
steps: Pick up stranger missions as you explore Leonida.
Finish each strand to its end.
Complete 8 strands in all.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a side-mission chain — follow it through and the finale closes the set.
steps: Take Randy's missions whenever they appear.
Play his final mission to the end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand runs as a side-mission chain — keep taking his missions and the finale unlocks at the end of it.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions whenever they appear.
Play his final mission to the end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy to plan around: the spots are spread over the whole state, so meditate at each spot the first time you reach its area instead of leaving the set for after the story. If any are left, sweep the map for the spots you have not visited and do them in one road trip.
steps: Meditate at each spot the first time you reach its area.
Keep the set moving as you travel — do not leave it for last.
PSN tracks the count to 18 spots.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt asks for one specific animal — follow his strand until the hunt is offered, then track the animal it names.
steps: Follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered.
Track and hunt the animal it names.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida and each set needs every card in it, so collect as you explore and use the set list to see which cards are still missing.
steps: Pick up cards as you explore Leonida.
Check the set list for missing cards.
Complete 3 full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK spots are scattered across the state — 100 of them. Fold them into your exploration: hit each spot as you pass its area and the count climbs without a dedicated grind.
steps: WAiNK It at each spot you pass.
Sweep leftover areas at the end.
PSN tracks the count to 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's small tasks and they stack up naturally across every other goal, so check the challenge list when you are close and mop up the easy ones.
steps: Play normally — challenges complete as you go.
Check the list when close to 50 and finish the easy ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
steps: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you.
Break line of sight and leave the search area.
Stay clear until the stars are gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them in one run and keep moving — stopping to fight is what loses the streak.
steps: Pick three shops close together.
Rob all three in one run with your partner.
Keep moving and keep the wanted level alive.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A new vehicle type counts when you first drive it — variety is what matters, not repeats. Keep hopping into anything you have not driven yet.
steps: Drive every new vehicle type you find.
Skip repeats — only new types count.
PSN tracks the count to 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group the enemies first, then trigger Combat Focus when five are in reach — open areas with clustered enemies are the place to try it.
steps: Find a spot with five enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down all five in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). The official description names the place, not the method — the natural reading is a runway departure that is not a scheduled flight, so experiment at the airport until it pops.
steps: Get to VCIA, the airport.
Leave by the runway, not by a scheduled flight.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The Rhinos are tanks, and the description is a joke rather than a method — expect this one to pop from a tank encounter in the open world, so keep playing and watch for Rhinos at high wanted levels.
steps: Keep playing into the open world.
Deal with Rhinos (tanks) when they show up.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, nobody spotting you. Plan the entry, take what you came for, and leave the same way you came in.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Take the goods without being seen.
Leave undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each vault is its own job — five vaults robbed and escaped from earns the silver. Plan the getaway before the break-in, not after.
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape clean.
Repeat for 5 vaults in all.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck, take its cargo, and get clear before the response arrives — the escape is half the trophy, so plan your exit route first.
steps: Stop an armored truck.
Take its cargo and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks areas as you visit them — drive the state end to end and check the map for the gaps you have not covered yet.
steps: Drive through every part of the map.
Check the map for unvisited areas.
PSN tracks the count to 52 areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang, nine gangs in all — work through the gangs one at a time and keep a note of which are done.
steps: Find an illegal operation for one gang and rob it.
Repeat for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail — a quiet moment, not a mission.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail at a bar with a view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a showroom and leave through the front in the loudest way possible — the classic GTA exit is the whole point.
steps: Drive into a vehicle showroom.
Smash your way back out through the front.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at that alley — the trophy is about the follow-through, so finish the game you start.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a frame through to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description names no mission or place, so this one reads as a story beat with your partner: keep playing the story together and it should unlock on its own. If it has not popped by the finale, replay the partner missions.
steps: Keep playing the story with your partner.
If it has not popped by the finale, replay the partner missions.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500 for this one — the choices you make across the game add up. Play normally and the count climbs; it is a long-haul trophy, not a single moment.
steps: Keep making choices as you play.
PSN tracks the count to 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description points at succeeding on a second attempt — keep playing and it pops when something clicks the second time around. There is no single named task, so do not grind for it; it comes with normal play.
steps: Keep playing — it comes with normal play.
It pops when something succeeds on the second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — a random encounter or easter egg. Explore the odd corners of the map and it will find you; the description deliberately gives nothing away.
steps: Explore the odd corners of Leonida.
Watch for strange encounters as you travel.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive by and knock someone down with a melee weapon — the bowling pun is the hint: one clean hit from a moving vehicle does it.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Knock someone down with a melee drive-by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and jobs — launder them through your contacts and the total builds to $250,000. Keep laundering as you earn instead of sitting on marked bills.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and jobs.
Launder them through your contacts.
Build the laundered total to $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts toward the total — clothes, weapons, food, whatever you buy. Spend as you play and it adds up; larger purchases move it fastest.
steps: Buy what you need as you play.
Larger purchases move the total fastest.
Spend $100,000 across all shops in all.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought, not found — save up and buy all eight. They double as storage, so buy them as you need the space.
steps: Save up for garage properties.
Buy all 8 garages.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, register each one in the app, and repeat until ten are on the books.
steps: Find a vehicle you have not registered.
Register it in the Scooter Bros app.
Repeat until 10 are registered.
